attribution: GeoSpec W5b bore termination fixtures: replicad blocks drilled with makeCylinder, then chamfered, filleted or counterbored, written by replicad's blobSTEP (OCCT STEPControl_Writer).
runtimeDependency: All runtime inputs are files in this directory. The generator locator is attribution only and is never read by the test.
bytePolicy: Byte-locked assets: do not reformat, regenerate, or alter expectations. The STEP headers carry the generation timestamp, so regeneration is not byte-identical.

files.description: Block 40 x 40 x 10 with a through bore r = 3 (makeCylinder cut); its top rim chamfered 1 mm (a reversed cone).
As t0 with a 2 mm chamfer: a countersink.
As t0 with the top rim filleted 1 mm (a torus on the inner half of its tube).
As t0 with both rims chamfered 1 mm.
Through bore r = 3 with a coaxial counterbore r = 5 from z = 6 to the top: the counterbore band ends on its floor annulus.
Through bore r = 3 with an internal groove r = 5 from z = 4 to 6: the groove band ends on two annuli and is no hole.
Blind bore r = 3 from z = 4 to the top, its top rim chamfered 1 mm.
